title: Milestone 1: AppLocker Schema Bugfix & AI Harness Initialization
summary: Fixed AppLocker XML schema validation in PolicyBuilder.ps1 where HighSection='*' violated XSD pattern ([0-9]{1,5}.){3}[0-9]{1,5}. Corrected to 65535.65535.65535.65535. Initialized living harness memory at PROGRESS.md and GEMINI.md.

title: Milestone 2: Child App Time Tracking & Daily Allowance Enforcement
summary: Implemented active foreground window tracking (IForegroundTracker, WindowsForegroundTracker), pure domain logic in TimeLimitTracker with 5m warning notification, automatic termination upon limit exhaustion, parent PIN bonus time (+15m/+30m), midnight rollover, and 14-day history pruning. Created TimeLimitEditor WPF UI and 13 unit tests.

title: Milestone 3: UI Hang Elimination via Non-Blocking Win32 APIs & Icon Caching
summary: Diagnosed UI thread lockup root causes: Process.MainModule blocked on loader locks in games/processes with anti-cheat hooks. Replaced with Win32 OpenProcess(PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION) + QueryFullProcessImageName + ProcessIdToSessionId. Consolidated triple process sweeps in Tick() into a single batched pass. Added ConcurrentDictionary icon cache in ExecutableIconConverter to stop synchronous disk I/O during WPF renders.

title: Milestone 4: Progressive Modularization & Rule #1 Line Budget Ratchet
summary: Deconstructed MainWindow.xaml.cs (298 lines) into 4 cohesive submodules: MainWindow.xaml.cs (128 lines), MainWindow.Blocklists.cs (88 lines), MainWindow.Session.cs (47 lines), and MainWindow.Settings.cs (83 lines). Added real process termination integration tests with FocusFence.Probe.exe. 100% of production files now adhere to Rule #1 budget (<150 hard ceiling, <120 target).

title: Milestone 5: Application Select List for One-Click Limit Configuration
summary: Enhanced TimeLimitEditor with an AppPicker ComboBox listing discovered desktop and running applications via IAppCatalog. Selecting an application auto-populates the app name and executable path, defaulting the daily limit to 60 minutes. Eliminated manual typing of names and paths. Verified via UI smoke test.

title: Milestone 6: Complete Submodule Modularization & Line Budget Verification
summary: Enforced AI Harness Rule #1 strict line budget (< 120 lines target, < 150 lines ceiling) across all repository code. Decomposed ManageAccount.ps1 (238 lines) into 5 focused submodules (ManageAccount.ps1, AdminPreflight.ps1, BackupSecurity.ps1, AccountUi.ps1, UninstallerInventory.ps1, SummaryFormatter.ps1). Decomposed test harnesses UiSmoke and FocusFence.Tests into dedicated fakes and helper modules. 100% of all 63 files across src, tests, and tools are now <= 120 lines with 0 violations and 0 warnings.
